resources.string: Enable USB debugging to let Tsuyu start on this TV.
In Settings, open “About” and press “Build” seven times. Then return here to continue.
Enable “USB debugging” in developer options. The port stays open on the local network, but only authorized devices can connect.
On the system prompt, select “Always allow”, then confirm with your remote. Tsuyu is waiting for your response.
Tsuyu is preparing the service and checking its access. You can cancel.
The service is running on your TV. Keep USB debugging enabled: turning it off may stop the service.
Start the service to restore its access on this TV.
Tsuyu is checking the service and your TV’s settings.
Open the TV settings manually and check USB debugging. Return here, then try again.
The USB debugging status is unavailable. Check it in the TV settings, then return here to try again.
No compatible local connection is available. Check USB debugging, then try again. This version requires local TCP debugging.
The private key cannot be read. Reinstall Tsuyu to create a new one, then authorize it on the system prompt.
The local connection failed. Check the authorization prompt, then try again.
The request timed out. Check the system prompt and USB debugging, then try again.
A previous check is no longer responding. Wait for it to finish or reopen Tsuyu, then try again.
The local connection is authorized, but the service did not confirm startup. Keep USB debugging enabled, then try again. You do not need to clear authorizations.

Enable USB debugging, then start Tsuyu. On the first system prompt, select “Always allow”. Keep debugging enabled while using the service. Once “Start after reboot” is set up, Tsuyu restarts automatically after a TV reboot or an update. Otherwise, or after enabling debugging again, open Tsuyu and start the service.

Local server running · shell UID: 2000. The startup ADB connection is closed. Keep USB debugging enabled: turning it off may kill the server. It stops when the TV reboots or Tsuyu updates, then restarts automatically if start after reboot is set up.
The local server is not running. Startup uses a local ADB connection with Tsuyu’s private key.
This app will be able to control your TV with debugging privileges. Only allow apps you trust.
These apps share access: allowing or revoking it affects the whole group.
Revoking access also stops the affected privileged processes and apps.
The request expired or the service is unavailable. Open Tsuyu, check the service and try again. An incomplete revocation must be retried.
Revocation is incomplete. Try again to finish stopping the affected processes and apps. Refreshing the list is not enough.
Access not delivered: %1$s. Reopen these apps. If the problem persists, check that they support this API or reinstall them, then restart Tsuyu.
The service is running, but client access failed. Reopen the affected app and try its request again. If the problem persists, restart Tsuyu.
Tsuyu will allow itself to start after reboot on compatible TVs. Keep USB debugging enabled. This does not disable key expiry: after a long time powered off, confirmation may be needed.
Start after reboot is set up. Both startup permissions have been verified. Keep USB debugging enabled.
Android startup is enabled. This TV does not provide the verified manufacturer permission: automatic restart still needs confirmation.
Startup permissions are not verified. Check USB debugging, then repair startup. The running service is shown separately.
Setup or verification failed. Check USB debugging in settings, then refresh or try again.
Restart failed: open “Start after reboot” to repair it.
Optional: avoid confirming again after a long time powered off. Disabling expiry affects all authorized debugging keys, not just Tsuyu. Keeping the policy does not block startup.
Expiry is already disabled for all keys. Tsuyu will not reapply this option if you change the system policy.
The result is unverified. A change may have occurred. Refresh to read the policy before trying again. Normal startup is still available.
Verified global policy: %1$d ms (0 = no expiry)
Revoking access also stops the affected apps. Allowing a new request grants no access: the app must ask for your permission again.
The request could not be reset. Check that the service is running, then try again. No access was granted.
Installed: %1$s. Tsuyu restarts automatically after the update and apps reconnect.
Start Tsuyu to install the update.
Version %1$s verified. It will install automatically once no app is using Tsuyu.
Network unavailable. Check the TV’s connection, then try again.
The request timed out. Check the TV’s connection, then try again.
The response could not be read. Try again later.
Too many recent checks. Try again later.
This version is no longer available. Nothing was installed.
Update rejected: invalid file (size mismatch). Nothing was installed.
Update rejected: invalid file (digest mismatch). Nothing was installed.
Update rejected: invalid file (different app). Nothing was installed.
Update rejected: invalid file (inconsistent version). Nothing was installed.
Update rejected: invalid file (different signature). Nothing was installed.
Android rejected the installation. The service and your permissions are unchanged. Try again later.
Set up “Start after reboot” so Tsuyu restarts automatically after the update.
Choose Tsuyu’s language. Changes apply immediately and do not change the TV’s language.
System language not supported. System mode uses %1$s.
The language could not be checked or changed. Try again or return to Home, then reopen this screen.
